transcript: I just got back from seeing Theater Adult with John Marcos, Horace, and special guest Ben Platt. And I want to tell you about it because I've been dying to see one of these shows for a while. I mean, it's a comedy show for theater kids. Like, truly could not be more up my alley, but it always sells out, like, immediately. And this one I happened to see right when it was first posted, and I was able to grab a ticket, and it was truly everything. We started with a vocal warm up and a group sing along to Be Our Guest from beauty and the Beast. Then they brought out the opener, who is Douglas Goodheart. You may know him from his master it videos that have gone viral on here. And then John Marco came out and did his set, and he's doing all the John Marcos. He's leaning on stools, he's doing crowd work. All of the crowd work was focused on asking audience members about past shows that they've done. And he even brought up a few audience members to the stage to perform songs from their past, which was crazy. But the set was really funny. It is all jokes that I think would only land in a room full of theater kids, but that's kind of the fun of the show. These are jokes that you're not gonna get anywhere else because they're so niche. And then for the back half, He brought out Ben Platt, who he interviewed about growing up as a theater kid and the roles that he played as a child. He even reprised some of those roles for us, singing songs from guys and dolls. Kriegen Sie Lieber sau Pippen into the woods. So it's your fault. See? It's her fault. Yes, it is. It's not. It's true. Wait a minute. Hairspray. It takes two, baby. Shout out to Matthew Morrison. Which was just so fun to see. And Ben Platt was clearly having a fun time with it. And then at the very end, Ben and John Marco sang a duet. They sang you're nothing without me from city of Angels, which is a deep cut. But that was just such a fun way to close out the night. And I will say, John Marco held his own against Ben Platt.
